phase: Phase 8 — Existing Mechanism Manifestation Gap Audit

main_manifestations: sequential two-booking one-shot certificate opportunity-cost allocation
summary.main_gap: Alternative allocation geometries, transaction graphs, ordering, applicability, and fallback structures are absent.

main_manifestations: Business cancellation permission versus flown-segment override
summary.main_gap: A second clean precedence relation is absent.
Only two downstream dependency types and one resource kind are represented; combination coverage is sparse.
No second scope dimension; the P5 composition adds context but not a new LGA04 boundary.

priority_ranking.reason: Only one focal scope dimension is admitted; existing audit evidence explicitly names passenger-count and other object-scope boundaries, although the examined instances are blocked or unsuitable.
Five states repeat exactly one allocation geometry, leaving poor future Train/Monitor structural generalization value.
Six states repeat one precedence relation; an alternative flown/cabin-change relation is known but currently backend-enforced and therefore not a ready candidate.
P3 already has real upstream and downstream structural variation; targeted work should focus on new downstream consumers rather than more state count.

manifestation_diversity_basically_adequa.qualification: Best-covered of the audited families and adequate for current use, but still PARTIAL rather than STRONG because downstream diversity is limited.

recommended_targeted_mining_order: LGA04: seek a clean, non-backend-enforced scope dimension beyond destination preservation
P4: seek a different transaction/allocation graph rather than another cheap-first two-booking instance
LGA01: seek a different clean precedence relation rather than more flown Business cancellations
P3: only after the high-priority gaps, seek a new downstream resource consumer or resource kind
